/games/brickbreak.description: Play Brick Break in your browser: bounce the ball with your paddle and clear the bricks.

/play/brickbreak.title: Brick Break
/play/brickbreak.description: Play synthwave Brick Break: clear 20 levels, collect power-ups, and chase a high score.
